description: Rifle Shooting teaches firearm safety and marksmanship: safety at home and on the range, laws and hunting ethics, rifle parts and care, shooting fundamentals, and qualifying with a modern rifle, air rifle or muzzleloader under a certified instructor.

safety.note: Shooting is done only on an approved range under a certified range officer and instructor, following the National Range and Target Activities Manual.

outlineNote: Rifle Shooting has general requirements and a choice of modern cartridge, air rifle or muzzleloader options, each with its own marksmanship standards. The excerpts used inconsistent numbering, so no requirement outline is published yet.
